same host, OS, simulator runtime, device class, and cache protocol

finding.summary: The ratified v2 Exact carrier correctly authenticates its target-local snapshot, protected artifacts, root bindings, and loaded Hermes image, but Ibex advertises no Apple target because the CapSec execution report is intentionally incomplete. Ordinary production construction therefore refuses before project code.

imageAttestationProbe.result: After adding exact loaded-image attestation for universal iOS Simulator Hermes frameworks, the Release carrier advanced from image-identity refusal to the distinct report-advertisement refusal.
imageAttestationProbe.refusal: engine target aarch64-apple-darwin with its exact features has no unique verified advertisement

conformanceInventory.interpretation: Completing the target advertisement is a separate security-conformance program, not a bounded prerequisite for measuring the current simulator carrier cost.

finding.notAProductOptimization: The observer does not change Contract, Snapback, the Partitime HBC, the native view tree, or the timed app work. It makes one previously implicit method precondition explicit and measurable; it does not improve a sample, rebaseline a threshold, or advertise an Ibex target.

observer.availability: default-off; iOS Simulator only; Release only; compile fails for device, desktop, Debug, and Q10 rebuild postures

substitutedGates.description: The report-derived target advertisement and its target-cell disposition lookup are replaced with Complete dispositions for the checked coverage-edge IDs.

Because the native fetch adapter has not yet migrated to staged typed-fetch authorization, only authenticated-root network:fetch:127.0.0.1 is admitted through the legacy adapter for the measurement gateway and witness. Empty, unknown, non-root, or mixed package stacks, every other hostname, and every non-fetch capability remain denied.

checksStillRequiredBeforeSubstitution: strict immutable snapshot and expected-identity authentication
construction-fresh run nonce and snapshot digest
protected package graph, policy, and Exact operation manifest artifacts
typed Exact app ingress and endowment validation
forbiddenClaims: equivalence between substituted target cells and executed conformance fixtures
observer.artifactIsolation: The observer uses a feature-scoped Cargo target directory. The linked archive build stamp binds the feature set, so a following ordinary build must replace the observer archive.
requiredRuntimeMarkers: [Ibex] CAPSEC_SIMULATOR_PERFORMANCE_OBSERVER_V1: authenticated artifacts; report target cells substituted

requiredValidation.quickProbeBeforeRatification: allowed only with claimEligible=false and no calibration/holdout promotion
rawExactReceiptsMustAttest: observer Cargo feature in the linked archive build stamp
